theorem: Every noncommuting address pair is connected by one symplectic transvection; every distinct commuting W33-adjacent pair requires exactly two. The practical address-routing diameter is two.
primitive_interpretation: Each transvection is a rank-one symplectic shear on F3^4. The exact generator regenerates the complete 1,600-pair canonical word library.
claim_boundary: Exact projective address words. This is a useful point-transfer library, not a shortest-word atlas for every element of A40. Optical loss is unmeasured.
